subject: Class cancelled: MKT201 (Section A) tomorrow 9:00 AM
bodyText: Dear Students, Please note that MKT201 Section A scheduled for tomorrow at 9:00 AM is cancelled as instructor is unwell. Makeup class schedule will be announced later by the department.

subject: Quiz 2 schedule - FIN201 (all sections), Tuesday 11:00 AM, MCC-12, chapters 4 to 6
bodyText: Dear Students of FIN201, Quiz 2 has been rescheduled to Tuesday 11:00 AM in MCC-12. Bring your scientific calculators. Mobile phones are strictly prohibited.

subject: Assignment 3 deadline extended - MKT201, Friday 11:59 PM, portal link
bodyText: Dear MKT201 students, The deadline for Assignment 3 has been extended to Friday 11:59 PM. Please submit your project reports on the LMS portal https://lms.iba.edu.pk before the cutoff.

subject: Fee challan Fall installment 2, last date without fine in 6 days
bodyText: Dear Students, Fee challans for Fall installment 2 have been uploaded. The last date to submit fees without surcharge is in 6 days. Challans can be downloaded from https://portal.iba.edu.pk.

subject: Spring course registration for Junior students, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM
bodyText: Dear Junior Students, Online course registration for Spring semester will open tomorrow from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Please clear all pending dues to avoid hold on enrollment.

subject: Midterm results declared - BS Computer Science Fall 2023 batch
bodyText: Dear BSCS Fall 2023 batch, Midterm results have been posted on the ERP portal. Any grade retotaling requests must be submitted within 3 days.

subject: Internship: Marketing Intern, apply within 10 days via job portal link
bodyText: Dear Students, Leading FMCG company is hiring Marketing Interns for Fall 2026. Eligible students can apply within 10 days via the CDC portal at https://jobportal.iba.edu.pk.

subject: Exchange applications open for Sophomores and Juniors
bodyText: Dear Sophomore and Junior students, Applications for semester exchange program in Europe and Turkey are now open. Deadline to submit statement of purpose and transcript is in 2 weeks.

subject: Zakat scholarship announcement Fall 2026
bodyText: Notice for needy students: Zakat scholarship and financial assistance applications for the academic year 2026 are invited. Apply through financial aid office with supporting income proof.

subject: Hostel mess timings revised for winter session
bodyText: All hostel residents are advised that mess dinner timings will now be from 7:30 PM to 9:30 PM starting Monday. Please observe discipline in dining halls.

subject: Seminar: Future of Fintech by the Finance Club, Thursday 2:00 PM
bodyText: Finance Club invites all students to a guest session on Fintech innovation with industry experts on Thursday at 2:00 PM in the G&T Auditorium. Refreshments will be served.

subject: Campus closed on Monday due to public holiday
bodyText: Dear Students, Faculty and Staff, Both Main Campus and City Campus will remain closed on Monday on account of public holiday. All classes stand postponed.

subject: Room change: ECO103 Section C moved from MCC-10 to MTS-6
bodyText: Dear Students of ECO103 Section C, Starting tomorrow your class venue has been shifted from MCC-10 to MTS-6 Main Campus for all remaining lectures.

subject: Attendance warning: FIN201, 3 absences recorded
bodyText: Student Warning Notice: You have accumulated 3 absences in FIN201 Section B. Any additional shortage will lead to deregistration from the course as per IBA attendance policy.

subject: Guest lecture for MBA Evening students on Corporate Governance
bodyText: Dear MBA Evening cohort, A specialized lecture on Corporate Strategy is scheduled this Saturday at 6:30 PM at City Campus. Attendance is mandatory for MBA Evening.

subject: BS Accounting and Finance Spring 2025 batch: ICAP workshop
bodyText: Attention BS Accounting & Finance students of Spring 2025 batch: Orientation for ICAP exemption route will be held in AP-03 this Wednesday at 1:00 PM.

subject: FIN201 Section B: Case study submission guidelines
bodyText: Dear FIN201 students, Please read the attached case study for Tuesday's discussion. You must submit your 2-page executive summary by Monday 5:00 PM on LMS.

subject: Point bus route shuttle timing changes for City Campus
bodyText: Notification to shuttle passengers: Point bus timings between Main Campus and City Campus are updated from next week. Check the shuttle notice board.

subject: Annual Alumni Reunion dinner registration open
bodyText: Dear Alumni and Final Year Graduating Batch, Annual Alumni Gala Dinner registrations are open. Early bird discount available for current graduating students.

subject: Graduation form submission for Senior students only
bodyText: Notice to Senior students graduating in Fall 2026: Please submit your clearance and degree audit forms at the Registrar counter before October 31st.

subject: Library maintenance at City Campus during weekend
bodyText: The City Campus library will be closed this Sunday due to electrical maintenance. Main Campus library remains open 24/7.

subject: Kal ki class nahi hogi - MKT201 makeup Sunday ko
bodyText: Dear Class, Kal ki lecture cancel hai. Hum make-up class Sunday 11:00 am ko online zoom par conduct karenge. Link LMS par share kar diya hai.

subject: Final exam datesheet Fall 2026 announced for all students
bodyText: Dear Students, The tentative final examination schedule and datesheet for Fall 2026 semester has been published on portal https://portal.iba.edu.pk.

subject: Course withdrawal deadline with W grade on transcript
bodyText: Dear Students, Last date to withdraw from a course with a 'W' grade is this Friday 5:00 PM. No withdrawal requests will be entertained after the deadline.

subject: Class announcement: MKT301 Brand Management syllabus
bodyText: Dear students registered in MKT301, the course outline and case schedule have been uploaded on portal. Please review prior to Monday class.

subject: Annual Sports Olympiad registration begins today
bodyText: Get ready for the biggest sports festival of the year! Football, cricket, badminton and table tennis tournaments open for registrations across all departments.

subject: Urgent: Management Trainee recruitment drive - apply in 2 days
bodyText: Top Multinational Bank MT recruitment closing in 2 days! All eligible students are encouraged to apply immediately through CDC portal.

subject: Make-up class announcement for FIN201 Section B
bodyText: Dear students, To cover the missed lecture on portfolio theory, make-up class will be held this Saturday at 10:00 AM in MTS-3 Main Campus.

subject: Quiz 3 announcement for ECO103 all sections
bodyText: Dear Students, Quiz 3 for Principles of Microeconomics (ECO103) will be conducted in class on Wednesday at 2:00 PM covering market structures.

subject: Khabarnama - October Monthly Campus Newsletter
bodyText: Catch up on faculty research publications, campus expansion updates, student achievements, and upcoming cultural activities in this month's issue of Khabarnama.
